description: This file defines the UiTweaksFragment class, a fragment used for UI tweaks settings in the AnySoftKeyboard app. It loads preferences from an XML resource and sets the activity title on start.

classes.name: UiTweaksFragment
classes.description: A fragment for UI tweaks preferences, extending PreferenceFragmentCompat.

methods.name: onCreatePreferences
methods.description: Loads preferences from the specified XML resource.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets the activity title to the 'tweaks_group' string resource when the fragment starts.
